name: Ichiki Yoshiyuki
source:
Dr. Ichiki Sousuke's father. He was a doctor at Nishikata Hospital.

[spoiler]He was the lead researcher of Nishikata Hospital's time leap research and eventually masterminded and died in the "Nishikata explosion accident" 7 years prior to the main story.[/spoiler]
